storyCards.headline: Eat It: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
"weird Al" Yankovic's "Eat It" reached #12 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #12 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 12 weeks on the chart.

Eat It was released in 1984.

Album: "Weird Al" Yankovic In 3-D (1984).
